primary_error: sqlalchemy.orm.exc.DetachedInstanceError during permissions response serialization/request middleware reuse
root_cause: Authenticated ORM objects were cached on request.state from a short-lived read session. Later middleware and response paths could touch expired or detached User/AuthSession attributes after the session was rolled back or closed.

resolution.summary: Cached a request-local snapshot of User and AuthSession scalar fields instead of session-bound ORM instances.
Returned a pure Pydantic owner response before invoking permission DB resolution.
Handled missing auth_sessions table by using legacy session compatibility for login and returning InvalidSessionError for invalid non-legacy sessions instead of leaking SQLAlchemy errors.

legacy_schema_runtime_guards.behavior: Use existing legacy session token flow for login when table is absent; stale non-legacy sessions return authentication failure instead of 500.
Use rollout backfill org context when C18 org tables are absent.
Use rollout backfill org context when owner org lookup cannot run on legacy schema.
Return empty module scope on legacy schema instead of failing org context build.
Return an empty policy list so live-gate bootstrap remains readable.

verification.backend_recent_logs_after_final_validati: only 200 OK entries observed for final permission/bootstrap requests
